blocks.heading: Greenhouse cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Greenhouse against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; No free/trial flag confirmed in SG data — budget a paid pilot.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (applicant tracking, career site and job boards, interview scheduling) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: No published list price — quotes scale with hiring volume and complexity, not recruiter seats alone. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.
